summary: Sets up camera/view geometry from a distance ratio and a computed 3D bounding box. The ratio is numerator (double at this+0x180) divided by divisor (double at this+0x28). After BoundingBoxComputation fills a 6-float vector, half-width = (box[0]-box[3])*0.5 + ratio is stored as a double at this+0x318 and half-height = max(box[1]-box[4], box[2]-box[5])*0.5 + ratio is stored at this+0x320. The view count at this+0x50 is set to 9, the diagonal distance sqrt(halfHeight^2+halfWidth^2) is stored as a float at this+0xCC, nine 12-byte view structures starting at this+0x5C are zeroed, nine entries are copied from the source array at this+0x58 into a 32-byte-per-entry local staging buffer, and finally VertexParticleBufferAllocator is called with the view count, whose result is returned.
